Definition: properly, to triturate (in a mortar), i.e. (figuratively) to agitate (by concussion)
BiblicalUsage: The word rûwph means to triturate (in a mortar), that is (figuratively) to agitate (by concussion). It stands in Job 26:11: "The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe rûwph is in the Bible for a reason, and even one mention is enough for God.
